zh-CN.title: 运行轨迹
zh-CN.description: 查看主 agent 与子 agent 已保存的执行步骤、实测耗时和失败与重试线索，并导出记录。

usage.title: 安装并重启
usage.description: 安装轨迹扩展，在 config.yaml 的 plugins 中启用后重启 Gateway。

usage.title: 打开会话轨迹
usage.description: 从会话菜单打开运行轨迹页，查看当前一轮或加载更早的记录。

usage.title: 定位与导出
usage.description: 定位耗时较长、失败或出现重试线索的步骤，展开证据，或导出 JSON 与 Markdown ZIP。

requirements: 依赖宿主已保存的 checkpoint；跨重启读取需要持久化 checkpoint 数据库及数据目录。
查看普通 task 子 agent 的内部步骤，需使用 SQLite 文件数据库，并启用 subagent_runtime.checkpoint_enabled。

en-US.title: Run trajectories
en-US.description: Inspect saved main-agent and subagent steps, measured durations and failure or retry evidence, and export the records.

usage.title: Install and restart
usage.description: Install the trajectory extension, enable it under plugins in config.yaml, and restart Gateway.

usage.title: Open a conversation trajectory
usage.description: Open the trajectory page from the conversation menu to inspect the latest turn or load earlier records.

usage.title: Locate and export
usage.description: Locate long-running steps, failures or retry clues, expand their evidence, or export JSON and Markdown ZIP files.

requirements: Reads checkpoints already saved by the host; inspection after restart requires a persistent checkpoint database and data directory.
Inspecting internal steps of ordinary task subagents requires a SQLite file database and subagent_runtime.checkpoint_enabled.
